newsitem.title: UK: UK cash grains lower on quiet market.
newsitem.headline: UK cash grains lower on quiet market.

text.p: UK cash grain prices were lower on Tuesday in thin trading as players digested Monday's news that the European Union may end its soft wheat export campaign early.
"If Brussels was looking for a way to make the market go down and stop trading they could not have hit on a better one," said a broker.
On the fob market Mar feed wheat traded at 96.75 stg a tonne ex-east coast ports.
May feed wheat was also reported traded at 99.50 stg, but brokers said this may not have been a straightforward deal and may have involved some delivered business.
Feed wheat in East Anglia was trading at 98.50 stg for Mar and down to 101 stg for Apr/Jun.
Barley was fetching 98 stg for Apr/Jun in East Anglia.
In the Midlands milling wheat 11 percent protein traded at 112 stg for Mar and 113 stg for Apr. --Jim Ballantyne, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8062
